_status: Owner's decision 2026-11-06, pre-registered before any 9-pair result: set before the expansion runs so it is not tuned on results. Edits need the owner.
_rule: A hypothesis passes exploration when at least K of the N enabled pairs are candidate_for_portfolio, K = min(N, max(exploration_min_pairs_floor, ceil(exploration_min_pairs_fraction * N))): 3 of 3, 6 of 9. The calibrated exposure must keep the bootstrap p95 drawdown within the limit on at least K pairs. Validation is read only on the pairs that were candidates at exploration (fewer pairs read, fewer lucky passes), and the autopilot starts bots only when at least validation_min_pairs of them pass.
_causality_note: Smoke, lookahead and recursive checks run on these pairs only (the longest histories); a lookahead bug is a property of the code, and checking 9 pairs would triple the check time.
